hook: Your colour newspaper photo is secretly made of tiny dots.
title: Your Newspaper Photo Is Made of Tiny Dots
description:
Colour photos in newspapers are printed using tiny dots of ink. Zoom your phone camera in close and the picture breaks apart into coloured dots. From far away, your eyes blend them into a smooth image.

#Shorts #Technology #PhoneTricks
comment_prompt: What colours did you see? Name one

scenes.narration: Your colour newspaper photo is secretly made of dots.
scenes.headline: A PHOTO MADE OF DOTS

scenes.narration: Grab any newspaper and open your camera.
scenes.headline: OPEN YOUR CAMERA

scenes.narration: Zoom in close on a colour picture.
scenes.headline: ZOOM IN CLOSE

scenes.narration: The photo breaks apart into coloured dots.
scenes.headline: IT BREAKS INTO DOTS

scenes.narration: Printers use just a few ink colours.
scenes.headline: JUST A FEW INKS

scenes.narration: Your eyes blend the dots into smooth colour.
scenes.headline: YOUR EYES BLEND THEM

scenes.narration: Move back and the dots disappear.
scenes.headline: STEP BACK, DOTS VANISH

scenes.narration: Your newspaper photo is just tiny dots. Tomorrow: another place that shouldn't exist.
scenes.headline: TOMORROW: A WEIRD PLACE
